    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">OpenClaw Linux 部署手册：常规安装、Docker 与 Docker Compose</span>

            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h2>OpenClaw Linux 部署手册：常规安装、Docker 与 Docker Compose</h2>
<p class="tag-line"><strong>标签：</strong> OpenClaw、Linux、Docker、Docker Compose、AI Agent、部署</p>
<p>OpenClaw 是 AI Agent Gateway，支持 CLI、常驻 Gateway、Control UI 和多渠道接入。Linux 是 <strong>官方推荐的生产部署平台</strong>，支持三种主流方式：</p>
<ol>
<li><strong>常规安装</strong> — curl 脚本 / npm 全局安装</li>
<li><strong>Docker 部署</strong> — 单容器或预构建镜像</li>
<li><strong>Docker Compose 部署</strong> — 官方推荐的生产方式</li>
</ol>
<p>本文按上述三种方式分别说明，含验收命令与常见问题。</p>
<hr>
<h2>一、系统要求</h2>
<table>
<tbody>
<tr>
<th>项目</th>
<th>要求</th>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>操作系统</td>
<td>Ubuntu 20.04+、Debian 11+、CentOS/RHEL 等主流 Linux</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Node.js（常规安装）</td>
<td>24（推荐）或 22.19+</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Docker（容器部署）</td>
<td>Docker Engine + Compose v2</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>内存</td>
<td>常规安装 ≥ 1 GB；Docker 本地构建镜像 ≥ 2 GB</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>磁盘</td>
<td>预留镜像、日志、配置目录空间</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>默认端口：</p>
<ul>
<li>Gateway：<strong>18789</strong></li>
<li>Bridge：<strong>18790</strong></li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h2>二、方式一：常规安装</h2>
<h3>2.1 一键安装脚本（推荐）</h3>
<pre class="highlighter-hljs"><code>curl -fsSL https://openclaw.ai/install.sh | bash</code></pre>
<p>跳过 onboarding：</p>
<pre class="highlighter-hljs"><code>curl -fsSL https://openclaw.ai/install.sh | bash -s -- --no-onboard</code></pre>
<h3>2.2 本地 prefix 安装（不依赖系统 Node）</h3>
<pre class="highlighter-hljs"><code>curl -fsSL https://openclaw.ai/install-cli.sh | bash</code></pre>
<p>OpenClaw 和 Node 安装在 <code>~/.openclaw</code> 前缀下。</p>
<h3>2.3 npm / pnpm / bun 全局安装</h3>
<pre class="highlighter-hljs"><code># npm
npm install -g openclaw@latest
openclaw onboard --install-daemon

# pnpm
pnpm add -g openclaw@latest
pnpm approve-builds -g
openclaw onboard --install-daemon

# bun
bun add -g openclaw@latest
openclaw onboard --install-daemon</code></pre>
<h3>2.4 配置与守护进程</h3>
<pre class="highlighter-hljs"><code>openclaw onboard --install-daemon</code></pre>
<p>Linux/WSL2 会创建 <strong>systemd user service</strong>，实现 Gateway 开机自启。</p>
<h3>2.5 验证</h3>
<pre class="highlighter-hljs"><code>openclaw --version
openclaw doctor
openclaw gateway status
curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:18789/healthz</code></pre>
<p>浏览器打开 <code>http://127.0.0.1:18789/</code>，在 Settings 粘贴 Gateway Token。</p>
<h3>2.6 从源码安装</h3>
<pre class="highlighter-hljs"><code>git clone https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw.git
cd openclaw
pnpm install &amp;&amp; pnpm build &amp;&amp; pnpm ui:build
pnpm link --global
openclaw onboard --install-daemon</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2>三、方式二：Docker 部署</h2>
<p>适合 <strong>不想污染宿主机环境</strong> 或 <strong>VPS 隔离运行</strong> 的场景。</p>
<h3>3.1 前置条件</h3>
<pre class="highlighter-hljs"><code># 确认 Docker 与 Compose v2
docker --version
docker compose version</code></pre>
<h3>3.2 使用官方 setup 脚本（推荐）</h3>
<p>克隆仓库后执行：</p>
<pre class="highlighter-hljs"><code>git clone https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw.git
cd openclaw
./scripts/docker/setup.sh</code></pre>
<p>使用 <strong>预构建镜像</strong>（小内存 VPS 推荐，避免 OOM）：</p>
<pre class="highlighter-hljs"><code>export OPENCLAW_IMAGE="ghcr.io/openclaw/openclaw:latest"
./scripts/docker/setup.sh</code></pre>
<p>脚本会自动：</p>
<ul>
<li>构建或拉取镜像</li>
<li>交互式 onboarding（API Key 等）</li>
<li>生成 <code>.env</code> 和 Gateway Token</li>
<li>通过 Docker Compose 启动 Gateway</li>
</ul>
<h3>3.3 手动 Docker 流程</h3>
<pre class="highlighter-hljs"><code>docker build -t openclaw:local -f Dockerfile .

docker compose run --rm --no-deps --entrypoint node openclaw-gateway \
  dist/index.js onboard --mode local --no-install-daemon

docker compose run --rm --no-deps --entrypoint node openclaw-gateway \
  dist/index.js config set --batch-json '[{"path":"gateway.mode","value":"local"},{"path":"gateway.bind","value":"lan"},{"path":"gateway.controlUi.allowedOrigins","value":["http://localhost:18789","http://127.0.0.1:18789"]}]'

docker compose up -d openclaw-gateway</code></pre>
<h3>3.4 打开 Control UI</h3>
<pre class="highlighter-hljs"><code>http://127.0.0.1:18789/</code></pre>
<p>获取 dashboard 链接：</p>
<pre class="highlighter-hljs"><code>docker compose run --rm openclaw-cli dashboard --no-open</code></pre>
<h3>3.5 健康检查</h3>
<pre class="highlighter-hljs"><code>curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:18789/healthz   # liveness
curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:18789/readyz    # readiness</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2>四、方式三：Docker Compose 部署（生产推荐）</h2>
<p>官方 <code>docker-compose.yml</code> 包含两个服务：</p>
<table>
<tbody>
<tr>
<th>服务</th>
<th>作用</th>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>openclaw-gateway</td>
<td>常驻 Gateway，对外暴露 18789/18790</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>openclaw-cli</td>
<td>一次性 CLI 容器，执行管理命令</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h3>4.1 标准 Compose 结构</h3>
<pre class="highlighter-hljs"><code>services:
  openclaw-gateway:
    image: ${OPENCLAW_IMAGE:-openclaw:local}
    environment:
      HOME: /home/node
      OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN: ${OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN}
    volumes:
      - ${OPENCLAW_CONFIG_DIR:-~/.openclaw}:/home/node/.openclaw
      - ${OPENCLAW_WORKSPACE_DIR:-~/.openclaw/workspace}:/home/node/.openclaw/workspace
    ports:
      - "${OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_PORT:-18789}:18789"
      - "${OPENCLAW_BRIDGE_PORT:-18790}:18790"
    restart: unless-stopped
    command:
      ["node", "dist/index.js", "gateway", "--bind", "lan", "--port", "18789"]

  openclaw-cli:
    image: ${OPENCLAW_IMAGE:-openclaw:local}
    network_mode: "service:openclaw-gateway"
    volumes:
      - ${OPENCLAW_CONFIG_DIR:-~/.openclaw}:/home/node/.openclaw
      - ${OPENCLAW_WORKSPACE_DIR:-~/.openclaw/workspace}:/home/node/.openclaw/workspace
    entrypoint: ["node", "dist/index.js"]</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>完整文件以官方仓库 <code>docker-compose.yml</code> 为准。</p>
</blockquote>
<h3>4.2 一键启动（setup 脚本）</h3>
<pre class="highlighter-hljs"><code>cd openclaw
export OPENCLAW_IMAGE="ghcr.io/openclaw/openclaw:latest"
./scripts/docker/setup.sh</code></pre>
<h3>4.3 常用 Compose 命令</h3>
<pre class="highlighter-hljs"><code># 启动 Gateway
docker compose up -d openclaw-gateway

# 查看日志
docker compose logs -f openclaw-gateway

# 停止
docker compose down

# CLI：添加 Telegram 渠道
docker compose run --rm openclaw-cli channels add --channel telegram --token "&lt;token&gt;"

# CLI：WhatsApp 扫码登录
docker compose run --rm openclaw-cli channels login

# 设备审批
docker compose run --rm openclaw-cli devices list
docker compose run --rm openclaw-cli devices approve &lt;requestId&gt;</code></pre>
<h3>4.4 环境变量（常用）</h3>
<table>
<tbody>
<tr>
<th>变量</th>
<th>用途</th>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>OPENCLAW_IMAGE</td>
<td>使用远程预构建镜像</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN</td>
<td>Gateway 认证 Token</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>OPENCLAW_CONFIG_DIR</td>
<td>配置目录挂载路径</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>OPENCLAW_WORKSPACE_DIR</td>
<td>工作区挂载路径</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>OPENCLAW_SANDBOX</td>
<td>启用 Agent Sandbox（1/true）</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>OPENCLAW_SKIP_ONBOARDING</td>
<td>跳过交互式 onboarding</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h3>4.5 持久化目录</h3>
<p>容器 bind-mount 以下路径，替换容器后数据保留：</p>
<ul>
<li><code>~/.openclaw</code> — 配置、<code>openclaw.json</code>、<code>.env</code></li>
<li><code>~/.openclaw/workspace</code> — Agent 工作区</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>权限注意：</strong> 容器以 uid 1000（node）运行，宿主机挂载目录需：</p>
<pre class="highlighter-hljs"><code>sudo chown -R 1000:1000 ~/.openclaw</code></pre>
<h3>4.6 启用 Agent Sandbox</h3>
<pre class="highlighter-hljs"><code>export OPENCLAW_SANDBOX=1
./scripts/docker/setup.sh</code></pre>
<p>Sandbox 在独立 Docker 容器中执行 Agent 工具，Gateway 仍在宿主机/主容器中运行。</p>
<hr>
<h2>五、三种方式对比</h2>
<table>
<tbody>
<tr>
<th>维度</th>
<th>常规安装</th>
<th>Docker</th>
<th>Docker Compose</th>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>上手速度</td>
<td>★★★ 最快</td>
<td>★★</td>
<td>★★</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>环境隔离</td>
<td>低</td>
<td>高</td>
<td>高</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>适合场景</td>
<td>个人本机/dev</td>
<td>单容器验证</td>
<td>VPS/生产</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>依赖</td>
<td>Node.js</td>
<td>Docker Engine</td>
<td>Docker + Compose v2</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>升级</td>
<td>openclaw update</td>
<td>拉取新镜像</td>
<td>compose pull + up</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<hr>
<h2>六、常见问题</h2>
<h3>1）构建镜像 OOM（exit 137）</h3>
<p>1 GB 内存 VPS 构建会失败。改用预构建镜像：</p>
<pre class="highlighter-hljs"><code>export OPENCLAW_IMAGE="ghcr.io/openclaw/openclaw:latest"
./scripts/docker/setup.sh</code></pre>
<h3>2）EACCES 权限错误</h3>
<pre class="highlighter-hljs"><code>sudo chown -R 1000:1000 ~/.openclaw</code></pre>
<h3>3）Gateway 重启循环</h3>
<p>检查 <code>gateway.bind</code> 是否使用了 <code>lan</code> 或 <code>loopback</code>，<strong>不要</strong>写 <code>0.0.0.0</code> 作为 bind 值。</p>
<h3>4）Docker 内访问宿主机 Ollama/LM Studio</h3>
<p>容器内用 <code>host.docker.internal</code> 替代 <code>127.0.0.1</code>：</p>
<table>
<tbody>
<tr>
<th>Provider</th>
<th>Docker 内 URL</th>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Ollama</td>
<td>http://host.docker.internal:11434</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>LM Studio</td>
<td>http://host.docker.internal:1234</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>宿主机服务需监听 <code>0.0.0.0</code>。</p>
<h3>5）openclaw 命令找不到（常规安装）</h3>
<pre class="highlighter-hljs"><code>export PATH="$(npm prefix -g)/bin:$PATH"
echo 'export PATH="$(npm prefix -g)/bin:$PATH"' &gt;&gt; ~/.bashrc</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2>七、结语</h2>
<p>Linux 部署 OpenClaw 的推荐路径：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>本机开发</strong> → <code>curl install.sh</code> 或 npm 全局安装</li>
<li><strong>VPS/生产</strong> → Docker Compose + 预构建 GHCR 镜像</li>
<li><strong>安全隔离</strong> → 启用 OPENCLAW_SANDBOX</li>
</ul>
<p>官方文档：https://docs.openclaw.ai/install</p>
<hr>
